RS symbols on piping represent restriction/spectacle blind sets for isolation of the exchanger. 4. The two fan/propeller symbols inside the vendor boundary represent cooling fans or drive impellers for the two drive trains A and B. 5. The capacitor/accumulator vessel symbols inside the vendor boundary represent pulsation dampeners or accumulators associated with each drive. 6. H-234-001 TRIP is a named safety interlock that receives input from TI-2917 (HH) and PSD-2917 and likely trips the drive trains via ESD-3200. 7. NOTE references (2, 4, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12) refer to drawing notes not visible in this image. 8. Off-page connector at bottom right references pipe line P-234-03304-CD3D-1-N to NOTE 12 sheet. 9. F3D/CD3D labels at outlet of E-234-009 indicate drain/blowdown line categories. 10. FREE DRAINING annotation on outlet piping indicates gravity-draining arrangement. 11. The KV-2904 with NOTE 8 on inlet utility line is a timed or key-operated valve with CSO (car-sealed open) block valves and a flow limiter (FL). 12. Some valve tags could not be uniquely identified from symbols alone; generic tags assigned. fault_diagnosis.repair_procedure:
PRIORITY REPAIR ACTIONS (Critical fault modes):
Reference: IEC 61511:2016+AMD1 Clause 5.2 — Functional Safety Management

  [TI-2909] LOW
    Effect  : Heating ramp-up — risk of overtemperature
    Detect  : NAMUR NE 107 Failure alarm
    Action  : Check wire continuity; replace sensor element

  [PSD-2917] FAIL_TO_OPERATE
    Effect  : Safety function fails dangerously — hazard not detected
    Detect  : SIL proof-test; PFDavg calculation
    Action  : Immediate proof-test; replace if failed; review SIL maintenance schedule

SAFETY INSTRUMENTED FUNCTION MAINTENANCE:
  Per IEC 61511-1:2016 Clause 16 (Proof testing):
  — Loop 2917: Verify sensor TT-2917, logic, and actuator  per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 2901A: Verify sensor VSHH-2901A, logic, and actuator MCC-A per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 2901B: Verify sensor VSHH-2901B, logic, and actuator MCC-B per SIL proof-test schedule.
